_comment: R32/R40: one single-edit mutant per invariant the exported conformance suite claims. `pnpm test:mutants` applies each to a temporary copy and requires it to be killed by a NAMED case listed in its `cases` — a non-zero exit alone is not a kill, and a load, syntax, stripping or timeout failure is a runner error that fails the run. `kills_by: "throw"` marks the mutants whose thrown error IS the defect (an accepted out-of-domain value that then throws); every other mutant must die on an assertion. Ids are this repository's; `was` records the round-4 reviewer's id where their description identified the mutant. A claimed invariant with no mutant, or a mutant with no case, is the defect this list exists to prevent. `entry` names the suite that must kill a mutant: absent is the exported conformance suite, `v2` is the contracts-v2 console suites (tests/contracts/v2/*.test.ts), folded in from `mutants-v2.json` by the F2P wire-in (item 11); compile-time invariants of the v2 unit brands are checked by the `@ts-expect-error` blocks in money-units.test.ts under `tsc --noEmit`, which no runtime mutant can express.
